## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `80ebf09091f6f799c0168d56a7213a06238591e8`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` on an archive of the head, to test whether the platform-checklist anchors resolve; it stopped at its own self-test (generated spec module not built), so the anchors were read against the tree instead
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/publicForms.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PublicFormsSetupPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PublicFormsSetupPage.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/publicFormDesign.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/PublicFormsDesigner.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #36784 (card #36444, part 2: the Studio designer), reviewed against merge-base `d59d8751149d33eb21de31c090a907e7a6d824f0`. Two commits, 13 files, +2145 −45. Read with `git diff` / `git show` and the REST API; nothing was checked out or built. Inputs: the PR body, the card and ruling comment 7100386248, PR #36697's body and its round-3 record 7113373743 (N9, N10, N12). Code outside the diff was read but not reviewed: `form-routes.ts`, `organization-ownership-apply.ts`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`, `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx`, `view.zod.ts`, `i18n.zod.ts`, `protocol.ts`.

- **S1 (should-fix): open.** A new form's name is checked only against the object's public forms, not against the object's other views. `newPublicFormName` gives `<object>.<address with underscores>`, and `nameTaken` (`PublicFormsDesigner.tsx:353-357`) looks in `listed`, which holds public forms only. A list view or the record form uses the same name space (`crm_lead.all`, `crm_lead.pipeline`, `crm_lead.form`; the designer test's own fixture lists `crm_lead.all`). A form created at address `all` is saved as a draft of `crm_lead.all` with `base: null`, so the body replaces the whole item, and Publish puts a form where the list view was. `ifNoneMatch: '*'` guards a pending draft, not the published item. In a writable package nothing refuses it. The fix is small: test the name against every item of the view list the effect already holds (`items`), and add a case.
- **S2 (should-fix): open.** "A saved design keeps every key it did not edit" does not hold for two shapes the spec accepts. (a) A section with no `name` (`FormSectionSchema.name` is optional). `publicFormModelOf` gives it the key `section_<n>` (`publicFormDesign.ts:172`), but `publicFormItemOf` looks the stored section up by its stored `name` (`:225-228`, `:235`), finds nothing, and writes the section from scratch. Its `description`, `columns`, collapse and visibility keys are lost, and so is every key of its field entries other than `field` and `required` (`sectionBody`, `:199-213`). (b) A label written as an inline locale map (`I18nLabelSchema` is a string or a map). `text()` reads it as empty, and the save then deletes it: a section `label` (`:210-211`) and `config.title` (`:231-232`). Any save of such a form, with nothing edited in those places, drops them. Neither shape has a test case.
- **S3 (should-fix): open.** The saved body carries the form's switch as the designer read it when the form was opened (`publicFormDesign.ts:191`, `:236-239`), so the claim "switching a form on or off stays Setup's" is not held by the write. Detail is with the seat, outside this record.
- **N1:** The corrected docblock names Setup's page as the console caller. The designer's list now reaches the function through the same `markShippedOff`; the module named is still the one caller, so the text is accurate. Its closing sentence ("a form published only in an organization stays open there") predates this PR and reads oddly beside ADR-0131; it was not touched.
- **N2:** The PR body says Setup "now names a form by the designer's rule". `shownName` moved into `publicFormDesign.ts` as `publicFormShownName` with the same five steps in the same order. No name on Setup's page changes.
- **N3:** `publicFormItemOf` writes a few keys nobody edited: `columns: 1` on a section that had none, `label` set to the title, `type: 'simple'`, `data`, and an explicit `enabled: false` where the switch was omitted. Each is the value the form already had in effect, except `columns`, where an absent key and `1` may not render alike. A title cannot be cleared while the item has a `label`, because the model falls back to it on the next read.
- **N4:** `takenAddresses` reads the published list and this object's draft-only forms. It does not see another object's draft-only form, nor a published form's pending draft that changes its address, so two drafts can claim one address until one is published.
- **N5:** Opening a form that has a pending draft loads that draft, shows "Draft saved" and enables Publish, whoever saved it. That is Studio's ordinary draft → publish and an explicit act; it differs from Setup's rule by design. The chip does not say the draft may be another person's.
- **N6:** `shippedByApp` covers the open object's own app only. A form of the object shipped by a different read-only package is offered Delete and a plain save, and relies on the server's refusal.
- **N7:** The PR body's Verification section still names head `90ed3338c3`. The head is `80ebf09091`.

### ① Derived judgments

**The spec change is prose only.** `git diff` on `packages/spec` shows one file, +15 −12, and every changed line is a ` * ` comment line inside the docblock of `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`. No signature, export, schema or statement moved. `packages/spec/api-surface/**` and `export-origins/**` are not in the diff.

**The prose is accurate.** Callers of the function at the head, outside tests:

| Docblock claim | Source at head | Holds |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the anonymous form doors pass the environment's view list | `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts:201`, `findPublicFormView(views, withdrawalLayer, slug)` | yes |
| the v18 organization-ownership migration passes the organization rows it carries | `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts:1664` and `:1912`; `layer` is built from the organization's view rows | yes |
| the command is `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` | `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts:642-643` | yes |
| Setup's page passes an installed app's own document | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/publicForms.ts:226`, `[named]` | yes |
| no organization-scoped write door calls it | no call in `packages/metadata-protocol/src` | yes |

**N9, N10, N12 of record 7113373743.**

- N9 is closed: the docblock names the three callers and no longer names the write door. The two paragraphs that described what that door passed are removed with it.
- N10 is closed: lines 1876 and 1877 of `access-security.json` now give `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`, and the second commit moves the two `verify` strings at lines 1826 and 1838 as well. Read against the tree: `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` is at line 219 of that file and `anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals` at line 156. The one anchor left on `packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.ts` (line 1806) names `anonymousFormIntakeUnavailability`, which is still declared there (line 154). The test-file reference at line 1873 is a real file.
- N12 is closed: the switch is `disabled` when `row.unknown` (`PublicFormsSetupPage.tsx:280`), and the rendered Unknown case asserts `toBeDisabled()`. An Unknown row already read off, so the only action removed is a switch-on.

**The designer's list.** `markShippedOff` is now generic over the row shape and its body is unchanged. The designer passes its rows through it, so a form its app ships withdrawn is listed "Off (its app ships it off)" and a row whose layers cannot be read "Unknown". The render order (`!published`, `on`, `shippedOff`, `unknown`, off) cannot show On for either, because `markShippedOff` sets `on: false` for both. The designer test covers the override-switches-it-on case.

**Writes on an installed app, against part 1's rules.**

- A form the app ships is saved in the customization package with the override declared (`writeTarget`, `overrideDraftBody`); a declaration the stored document already carries is kept. The effective list serves an override under its base's package id (`protocol.ts`, ADR-0146 D8 item 2), so `shippedByApp` stays true once an override exists, and Delete stays refused.
- A new form goes to the pair from `customization.ensure()`.
- An app-shipped-off form stays closed whatever the designer publishes: the routes judge the app's own document, which the designer never writes.
- The gate is the server's: every write is a `save` / `publish` / `reset` on the metadata doors, and the ensure door judges the caller as before. The designer adds no door.
- A pending draft: see N5.

**Locale keys.** The designer and the surface control use 61 keys; all 61 are present in both `en.ts` and `zh.ts`, and the studio catalogue has only those two locales.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec: patch` is right: published declaration bytes change (a docblock), nothing an author or importer can observe.
- `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` and `@object-ui/i18n: patch` are right. The designer modules are not named in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` or the package manifest, so no export is added. `markShippedOff`'s signature is widened by a type parameter and accepts every earlier call.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` holds, for the new locale keys. The PR body's line also names the spec docblock; the changeset's line names the keys and states the docblock in its body. Both carry the same value.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: the stored shape is the form view item with `config.sharing` and `submitBehavior`, all existing keys. No route, error code, Setup nav id or component id is added; the Form tab gains a control and two test ids.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Ruling item 1 says Studio's Developer → Public Forms page is upgraded into the designer and placed under the object. This PR builds the designer under the object and leaves the Developer page (`nav_public_forms`) as it is. The PR body does not say what becomes of that page; the seat should state it on the card.
- With the designer, a pending draft on a public form becomes ordinary. Setup's switch refuses over a pending draft (part 1's rule, `'pending-draft'`), so a draft left unpublished in Studio stops an administrator from switching that form off in Setup until it is published or discarded. This is part 1's accepted rule meeting a new source of drafts; it is a product question for the seat, not a defect of this diff.
- Behaviour for an existing user: the Form tab opens on the record form as before; Setup's page changes only in the disabled Unknown switch.
- SQL push-down: no record query in the diff. The list makes one layered read per installed-app form, as Setup's does.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no separate login to name. The PR is a draft with auto-merge not armed.
- The PR touches no `.claude/**` path and declares no `Rule-change:` line.
- Check-runs at the head: 60 success, 10 skipped, none failed, none pending.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts` (hits): the docblock now describes the function as its callers use it. The identity paragraph keeps the one caller whose identity rule matters to a reader (the doors, by served item name, with the known limit). The removed text described a caller that does not exist, so a reader of the shipped declarations is no longer told a write door enforces this. Nothing a consumer could rely on changed.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/**`: the Unknown switch and the generic `markShippedOff` agree with the module header, which already says an unreadable row is never shown on.

`publicFormDesign.ts` and `PublicFormsDesigner.tsx`: the design is sound where the PR tests it. The fillable-field rule, the required-field rule (a default value or default option is not held, which matches the write path), the address rule over switched-off forms, the override path and the refusal to delete an app's form all hold against the code they rest on. It does not hold in three places: the name a new form takes (S1), the keys a save promises to keep (S2) and the switch value a save writes (S3). Each is a write that changes something the person did not edit.

Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5e8aaa4bc0751a4cd4071af088edbd759443261a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta `80ebf09091..5e8aaa4bc0` (one commit, 4 files, +299 −38): ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/publicFormDesign.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/PublicFormsDesigner.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/publicFormDesign.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/PublicFormsDesigner.test.tsx; and the PR body (v3)
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #36784 (card #36444, part 2: the Studio designer), second round. The first round is record 7117275850 at head `80ebf09091` (FAIL: S1, S2, S3). This round reads the one commit since, with `git diff` / `git show` and the REST API; nothing was checked out, built or run. `packages/spec` is not in the delta, so the first round's judgment of the docblock (prose only, accurate, `patch`) stands as written. Code outside the delta was read but not reviewed: `publicForms.ts`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `metadata-client.ts` (`getDraft`), `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, `meta-item-read-gate.ts`.

- **S1: closed.** The list effect now keeps every view item name of the environment: the published list's (`items`, every object and every view kind) and each pending view draft's (`viewNames`, `PublicFormsDesigner.tsx:188-193`). `nameTaken` tests the new form's name against that set (`:395`); it disables Create and `create()` returns early. The rendered case types the title "All" (name `crm_lead.all`, the fixture's list view) and then the address `form` (`crm_lead.form`, the record form): both leave Create disabled, `all-leads` enables it, and nothing is saved. The message shown is the used-address one; the PR body says so ("refused like a used address").
- **S2: closed.** (a) `sectionKeysOf` is the one rule for a stored section's key, and both `publicFormModelOf` and `publicFormItemOf` call it over the same `storedSections`, so an unnamed section is matched with what it stored. A positional key skips any key a named section holds: `[<unnamed>, section_1]` gives `section_2, section_1`, pinned. Field entries are looked up across all stored sections (`fieldsWas`, first occurrence), so a field moved to another section keeps its keys, pinned. (b) `publicFormItemOf` reads the base back through `publicFormModelOf` and writes a text only when the model's value differs from that read: `config.title` and the item `label`, `config.description`, each of the two thank-you texts, and a section's `label`. A locale map is therefore left as stored, and an edited text replaces it; both pinned.
- **S3: closed.** The save no longer writes the form's on/off switch from a stale read. Detail is with the seat, outside this record, together with one note on the publish step.
- **N3: closed.** `sectionBody` no longer writes `columns`; a new form's sections carry no `columns` key and a stored `columns: 1` is kept, pinned.
- **N7: closed.** Verification names head `5e8aaa4bc0` and the three commits.
- **Boundary flags: stated.** The PR body has a "Boundaries" section that says `nav_public_forms` stays as it is and its retirement is a follow-up for the card, and that a designer draft holds Setup's switch until it is published or discarded. N4, N5 and N6 are listed there as known limits.

New in this round, none blocking:

- **N8:** Publish may save the draft once more before it publishes. The body it saves is the `?state=draft` read's `item` (`client.getDraft`, `PublicFormsDesigner.tsx:320-326`) with its top-level `_` keys removed. That read is the decorated one, and the server translates it for the request's locale (`createMetaItemAnswer` step 5; `metadata-client.ts` says not to hand `.item` to a write and names `extractDraftBody` as its reader). The editor itself builds from the layered read's `draft` layer for this reason. On that path a title or label can be written back in the publisher's language over a stored key or locale map, which S2 (b) otherwise prevents. The path is taken rarely. The layered read made two lines earlier already carries the draft as stored.
- **N9:** A thank-you title stored as a locale map shows empty. Clearing the message then leaves both texts empty in the model, and the save removes `submitBehavior` whole, the unedited map with it (`publicFormItemOf`, the `else if (was)` branch).
- **N10:** A section stored without a `name` is written back with `name: section_<n>`, and the second of two sections stored under one name is written under a positional key. Both are keys nobody edited; neither changes what the form serves.
- **N11:** The rendered cases pin a fresh switch at save and the extra save before publish. Not pinned: a failed read refusing the write, the read at the app's package when the customization package holds nothing, and the publish case in the off direction (the code is the same for both directions).
- **N12:** The PR body counts 70 check-runs at the head (60 success, 10 skipped). The REST API lists 74 completed: 62 success, 12 skipped, none failed, none pending.

### ① Derived judgments

**The spec is untouched by the delta.** `git diff 80ebf09091 5e8aaa4bc0 -- packages/spec` is empty. The four files changed are the designer's two modules and their two tests.

**Each closing claim against the code.**

| Item | Claim in the PR body | Source at head | Holds |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| S1 | a name any other view item of the environment has is refused | `PublicFormsDesigner.tsx:188-193`, `:395`, `:398`, `:574` | yes |
| S2 (a) | an unnamed section is matched by the same positional key, never one another section uses | `publicFormDesign.ts` `sectionKeysOf`, called in `publicFormModelOf` and `publicFormItemOf` | yes |
| S2 (a) | a field moved to another section keeps its own entry keys | `fieldsWas` built over every stored section | yes |
| S2 (b) | a text the person did not change is kept as stored, a map included | `read` comparison in `publicFormItemOf`; `sectionBody` early return | yes, except N9 |
| N3 | no column count is written onto a section that had none | the `columns` line is removed from `sectionBody` | yes |
| S3 | the save no longer writes the switch from a stale read | `currentSwitch`, called in `save` and `publish` | yes |

**The new cases test what they name.** The unnamed-section case asserts the whole written section with `toEqual`, so a dropped key fails it. The clash case asserts the keys and that each label stays with its own `columns`. The locale-map case asserts the four stored maps after an unrelated edit, then that an edited title and section label replace them. The rendered name case and the two switch cases drive the component over a client double that now holds state (the served item and the saved drafts), so a second read sees what Setup or the designer wrote. The PR body reports that six of the seven new cases fail on the previous head's code; that was not re-run here.

**Writes on an installed app.** Unchanged from round one: `writeTarget` and `overrideDraftBody` are not in the delta apart from the model handed to them. The extra save before publish keeps the draft's own keys, the `overrides` declaration included, and goes to the package the draft is in.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from round one. The delta adds no export, no locale key, no route, no stored key and no component or test id that a consumer reads; `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`, `@object-ui/i18n: patch` and `@objectstack/spec: patch` still fit, and `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still hold.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Both flags of round one are now written in the PR body (above). They remain questions for the card, not defects of this diff.
- Behaviour for an existing user: none beyond round one. The designer is new in this PR.
- SQL push-down: no record query in the delta. A save makes one or two layered reads more than before, and a publish one layered read and one draft read more.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. The PR is a draft; mergeable state `clean`.
- The delta touches no `.claude/**` path and the PR declares no `Rule-change:` line.
- Check-runs at the head: 62 success, 12 skipped, none failed, none pending (N12).

### ④ Design judgment

`publicFormDesign.ts`: the write-back now has one rule for "edited", which is "differs from what the designer read from the same base", and one rule for a section's key. Both are stated in the docblocks and both are what the tests assert. The rule fails only where the model cannot tell two stored states apart (N9: a map and an empty text both read as empty), which is a limit of showing a locale map as an empty box, not of the write.

`PublicFormsDesigner.tsx`: the name check uses the list the effect already reads, as round one suggested. The switch is read where it is written, and a read that cannot answer refuses the write. The extra save before publish should take its body from the layered read, as the editor does (N8).

The three places where round one found a write changing something the person did not edit are closed. What is left (N8 to N12) is narrow and can follow on the card.
